## Issue and workstream identity
- Parent issue / Mission:
- Accountable human and operating agent:
- Existing branch and PR reviewed (link; reason a new branch was needed):
- Branch, target base and base SHA:
- Active owner, lease/checkpoint and source head SHA:
- Owned file scope and stacked PR dependencies:

## Safety and proof
- Change objective and canonical data/source owner:
- Test commands, exact source SHA and independent receipts:
- Security/authorization, data classes and external effects:
- Deployment/publishing/messaging/trading/research holds:
- Rollback and branch disposition:

## Required checks
- [ ] Reused existing workstream or documented separate sub-issue
- [ ] No overlapping agent ownership without an explicit handoff
- [ ] No force-update, uncontrolled side effect or unbudgeted hosted CI
- [ ] Exact branch SHA, acceptance evidence and rollback accounted for
- [ ] No branch deletion/close without owner-approved conservation

Policy: https://github.com/XG-Capital-Strategies/.github/issues/2
